topPRs.title: release: promote certified develop 769d433 to production
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Promote the current canonical `develop` source to production after the exact-SHA staging certificate completes. This release includes shared-runtime inference admission latency reduction and deterministic stream-settlement fixes relevant to phone voice turns.

## Source

- Develop SHA: `769d43393683cd248a87d57ea2928d79dce4cf82`
- Staging release: https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/33663526563
- Production base: `2223bdca0a07013abbc810fbbb507e11fd233dde`
- Merge-tree preflight: clean (`71ed6a18be8a3aac5ba2733e7f7283dc987e5302`)

## Voice evidence

- Shared voice SSE bridge: 32/32 passing on exact develop
- Cloud API WebSocket voice lifecycle: 73/73 passing on exact develop
- Covers canonical runtime, greeting/prewarm, barge-in zero post-cancel audio, TTS/provider errors, STT reconnect, and teardown/revocation

## Acceptance

- [ ] Exact-SHA staging deployment and health readback
- [ ] Production health reports the promoted merge SHA
- [ ] SIWE nonce healthy
- [ ] Real +1 808 788 1821 PSTN call: greeting, normal turn, barge-in, recovery, >60s conversation
- [ ] No Twilio/media/coordinator errors in correlated production logs

Provider routing is intentionally unchanged.

topPRs.title: feat(cloud): persist subscription lifecycle and allowance authority
topPRs.author: wtfsayo
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- persist provider-neutral subscription lifecycle aggregates with immutable revision history
- project organization entitlements from the canonical immutable plan catalog
- add durable checkout/change/cancel command recovery, event receipts, deletion fences, and incidents
- persist exact allowance periods, funding reservations, source allocations, and append-only allowance ledger entries
- keep successful checkout fenced until its provider result is linked to durable lifecycle authority

This establishes the persistence and recovery authority for #23091. Live metered debit orchestration remains scoped to #23092; this PR does not change existing purchased-credit debit callers or activate Stripe workflows.

Closes #23091

## Adversarial review

The design and implementation went through five adversarial rounds covering scope ownership, module boundaries, provider uncertainty/recovery, purchased-credit coexistence, migration/concurrency safety, and final PR readiness. Two independent final reviewers then iterated on the concrete diff until both reported zero confirmed blockers.

Review-driven fixes included database-time webhook leases, authoritative provider-object retrieval semantics instead of fake Stripe versions, coherent historical replay, immutable-catalog entitlement derivation, pre-subscription checkout commands, checkout crash-window fencing, digest-bound result linkage, cancellation accounting guards, and real repository concurrency coverage.

## Verification

Passing:

- `bun install`
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/shared typecheck`
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/shared lint`
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/shared db:check-migrations`
- focused subscription/schema/migration/account-deletion suite: 48 passed, 0 failed
- real PostgreSQL 16 integration suite: 1 passed, 0 failed, 9 assertions
  - simultaneous checkout: one admitted, one rejected
  - overlapping allowance periods: one admitted, one rejected
  - last-dollar reserve through `SubscriptionAllowanceRepository`: one success, one conflict, exactly one reservation/allocation/ledger row
  - reserve blocked behind the organization lock crosses expiry and rolls back without balance or funding mutation
- `git diff --check`

Repository-wide `bun run verify` reached 375/376 tasks after dependency installation, then stopped in the unrelated UI molecular-inventory gate because its generated JSON/Markdown artifacts are stale. No UI files are touched here, so those unrelated generated artifacts were not rewritten or included.

The full cloud-shared suite also currently stops in the pre-existing dormant backup/restore API-boundary inventory test (`acquireAgentBackupRestoreLease must remain definition-only`); the focused changed contracts above pass.

## Evidence applicability

- UI screenshots/video/frontend logs: N/A — no rendered surface changed
- live Stripe calls: N/A — provider integration is deliberately not activated by this persistence PR
- live mixed allowance/purchased-credit debits: N/A — caller orchestration remains #23092
- model trajectories: N/A — no model behavior changed
